description: Luxury lifestyle, premium banking, travel, concierge, hospitality, loyalty and experiences.

entity_extensions.offering: A named card programme, concierge programme, membership, premium travel package, loyalty proposition or experience bundle.
entity_extensions.service: A concrete premium service: concierge assistance, restaurant reservation, lounge access, airport meet-and-assist, chauffeur transfer, private aviation coordination, hotel booking, yacht charter, event access, art advisory or employee lifestyle support.
entity_extensions.customer_segment: A buyer or beneficiary group: premium cardholders, private-banking clients, high-net-worth individuals, ultra-high-net-worth families, independent travel advisors, family offices, corporate travellers or luxury leisure guests.
entity_extensions.loyalty_program: A specifically named points, rewards, membership-rewards or frequent-flyer programme. Do not classify a card tier or general benefit as a loyalty programme.
